notes: Fiscal year ended September 29, 2024 (Starbucks fiscal 2024; matches data.js fy 'Sep 2024'). Sources: FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0000829224-24-000057) and the proxy published after that year, the 2025 DEF 14A (accession 0001213900-25-006516, ownership as of January 10, 2025). HOWARD SCHULTZ is not listed in the 2025 proxy's beneficial ownership table, which covers more-than-5% holders, current directors and nominees, the fiscal 2024 named executive officers, and the current group. He is not a current director or officer; elsewhere the proxy mentions him only as a former CEO (in the pay-versus-performance table and in a shareholder proposal's supporting statement). Under the schema rule for former executives, status is no-reported-stake. That means the proxy reports no holding, not that he owns no shares. The cited source quote shows the table's scope. 5% HOLDERS: both rest on Schedule 13G/As reporting holdings at the end of 2023, so they are stale relative to the January 2025 share count. GEOGRAPHY: revenues include the Channel Development segment; Japan, Canada and the U.K. together make up about 72% of 'Other countries' (10-K). Operating segments (North America, International, Channel Development) are not used.
